Métricas: HIS, HIS_span, incertidumbre\n\n- `HIS_raw` $=1-|\\Delta|/|\\langle H\\rangle_{id}|$ (definición original; **no invariante** a $cI$).\n- `HIS_span` $=1-|\\Delta|/(\\lambda_{max}-\\lambda_{min})$ (invariante a $cI$; $\\in[0,1]$ para estados físicos).\n- SE por método delta: $\\mathrm{SE}(\\mathrm{HIS})=\\mathrm{SE}_H/\\text{escala}$, con $\\mathrm{SE}_H$ de la distribución de energía por shot de cada grupo de medida.\n- Bootstrap multinomial sobre los conteos (SE = desviación de la distribución bootstrap).","metadata":{}},{"id":"46f7af7b","cell_type":"code","source":"def his_raw(h_id, h_re):\n    d = abs(h_id)\n    return float(\"nan\") if d < EPS else 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / d\n\ndef his_span(h_id, h_re, span):\n    return 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / span\n\ndef z_diff(a, sa, b, sb):\n    s = math.sqrt(sa**2 + sb**2)\n    return float(\"nan\") if (s < EPS or math.isnan(s)) else (a - b) / s\n\ndef group_stats(counts, op, n):\n    \"\"\"Valores de energía por bitstring para un grupo qubit-wise commuting.\"\"\"\n    labels = op.paulis.to_labels()\n    coeffs = np.real(op.coeffs)\n    keys, vals, cnt = [], [], []\n    for bs, c in counts.items():\n        s = bs.replace(\" \", \"\")[-n:].zfill(n)\n        e = 0.0\n        for lab, w in zip(labels, coeffs):\n            par = 0\n            for i, ch in enumerate(lab):\n                if ch != \"I\" and s[i] == \"1\":\n                    par ^= 1\n            e += w * (1 - 2 * par)\n        keys.append(s); vals.append(e); cnt.append(c)\n    cnt = np.array(cnt, float)\n    shots = cnt.sum()\n    return np.array(vals), cnt / shots, int(shots)\n\ndef estimate_energy(groups_counts, groups_ops, n):\n    h, var = 0.0, 0.0\n    for counts, op in zip(groups_counts, groups_ops):\n        v, p, shots = group_stats(counts, op, n)\n        m = float(p @ v)\n        h += m\n        var += float(p @ (v**2) - m**2) / shots\n    return h, math.sqrt(max(var, 0.0))\n\ndef his_bootstrap(groups_counts, groups_ops, n, h_id, span, n_boot=N_BOOT, rng=None):\n    rng = rng or np.random.default_rng(SEED)\n    stats = [group_stats(c, op, n) for c, op in zip(groups_counts, groups_ops)]\n    hs = np.zeros(n_boot)\n    for v, p, shots in stats:\n        hs += (rng.multinomial(shots, p, size=n_boot) @ v) / shots\n    sp = 1.0 - np.abs(h_id - hs) / span\n    return float(sp.mean()), float(sp.std(ddof=1)), tuple(np.percentile(sp, [2.5, 97.5]))\nprint(\"métricas listas\")","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T11:09:45.920723Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T11:09:45.921047Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T11:09:45.955052Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T11:09:45.921021Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T11:09:45.954007Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"métricas listas\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":9},{"id":"4909680f","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 3. Hamiltonianos y estados de referencia (revisión)\n\n- **T1 MaxCut** (path): $H=\\sum_{e}\\tfrac12(I-Z_iZ_j)$, diagonal; estado = QAOA p=1 con ángulos óptimos ideales. $AR=\\langle H\\rangle/(n-1)$.\n- **T5 Random Pauli**: $H=\\sum_{P\\in\\{X,Y,Z\\}}\\big[\\sum_i J^P_i P_iP_{i+1}+\\sum_i h^P_i P_i\\big]$ con coeficientes aleatorios (seed fijo). **No diagonal**, no ligado a MaxCut, exactamente **3 ajustes de medida** (todo-X, todo-Y, todo-Z). Estado = ansatz hardware-efficient de profundidad 3. La semilla (entre 300) se elige maximizando $|\\langle H\\rangle_{id}|/\\text{span}$ y se exige $\\ge$ `COND_MIN`.","metadata":{}},{"id":"14b1f3ac","cell_type":"code","source":"def plabel(n, ops):\n    s = [\"I\"] * n\n    for q, l in ops.items():\n        s[n - 1 - q] = l\n    return \"\".join(s)\n\ndef maxcut_H(n):\n    t = [(\"I\" * n, 0.5 * (n - 1))]\n    t += [(plabel(n, {i: \"Z\", i + 1: \"Z\"}), -0.5) for i in range(n - 1)]\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t)\n\ndef random_pauli_H(n, seed):\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    t = []\n    for l in \"XYZ\":\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: l, i + 1: l}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.5))))\n        for i in range(n):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: l}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.4))))\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t).simplify()\n\ndef build_prep(kind, n, idle=None, qaoa=(0.8, 0.4), hea=None):\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)\n    if kind == \"T1\":\n        g, b = qaoa\n        qc.h(range(n))\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1); qc.rz(-g, i + 1); qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n        if idle: idle(qc, \"cost\")\n        qc.rx(2 * b, range(n))\n        if idle: idle(qc, \"mixer\")\n    else:\n        L = hea.shape[0]\n        for l in range(L):\n            for q in range(n):\n                qc.ry(float(hea[l, q, 0]), q); qc.rz(float(hea[l, q, 1]), q)\n            for i in range(n - 1):\n                qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n            if idle: idle(qc, f\"L{l}\")\n    return qc\n\ndef h_ideal(prep, H):\n    return float(np.real(Statevector.from_instruction(prep).expectation_value(H)))\n\ndef spectrum_span(H):\n    ev = np.linalg.eigvalsh(H.to_matrix())\n    return float(ev[-1] - ev[0]), float(ev[0]), float(ev[-1])\n\ndef best_qaoa(n):\n    H = maxcut_H(n); best = (-1e9, 0, 0)\n    for g in np.linspace(0.05, np.pi, 16):\n        for b in np.linspace(0.05, np.pi / 2, 12):\n            v = h_ideal(build_prep(\"T1\", n, qaoa=(g, b)), H)\n            if v > best[0]:\n                best = (v, g, b)\n    return (best[1], best[2])\n\nN = N_LOGICAL\nQAOA = best_qaoa(N)\n\nH_T1 = maxcut_H(N)\nprep_T1 = build_prep(\"T1\", N, qaoa=QAOA)\n\n# búsqueda conjunta (semilla de H, semilla del ansatz) maximizando |<H>|/span\n_cands = []\nfor sd in range(100):\n    Hc = random_pauli_H(N, sd)\n    _cands.append((sd, Hc, spectrum_span(Hc)[0]))\n_best = (-1.0, None, None, None)\nfor hs in range(30):\n    hea_c = np.random.default_rng(SEED + 1 + hs).uniform(0, 2 * np.pi, (3, N, 2))\n    sv = Statevector.from_instruction(build_prep(\"T5\", N, hea=hea_c))\n    for sd, Hc, span_c in _cands:\n        ratio = abs(float(np.real(sv.expectation_value(Hc)))) / span_c\n        if ratio > _best[0]:\n            _best = (ratio, sd, Hc, hea_c)\nT5_RATIO, T5_SEED, H_T5, HEA = _best\nif T5_RATIO < COND_MIN:\n    print(\"AVISO: |h_id|/span = %.3f < COND_MIN (%.2f). HIS_raw de T5 queda mal condicionado; usa HIS_span (primario).\" % (T5_RATIO, COND_MIN))\nprep_T5 = build_prep(\"T5\", N, hea=HEA)\n\nHAM = {\n    \"T1\": dict(H=H_T1, prep=prep_T1, kind=\"T1\"),\n    \"T5\": dict(H=H_T5, prep=prep_T5, kind=\"T5\"),\n}\nfor k, d in HAM.items():\n    d[\"h_id\"] = h_ideal(d[\"prep\"], d[\"H\"])\n    d[\"span\"], d[\"lmin\"], d[\"lmax\"] = spectrum_span(d[\"H\"])\n    d[\"groups\"] = []\n    for g in d[\"H\"].group_commuting(qubit_wise=True):\n        labs = g.paulis.to_labels()\n        basis = []\n        for q in range(N):\n            letters = {lab[N - 1 - q] for lab in labs} - {\"I\"}\n            assert len(letters) <= 1\n            basis.append(letters.pop() if letters else \"Z\")\n        d[\"groups\"].append(dict(op=g, basis=basis))\n\ndef review_hamiltonian(name, d):\n    H = d[\"H\"]\n    ident = float(np.real(sum(c for lab, c in zip(H.paulis.to_labels(), H.coeffs) if set(lab) == {\"I\"})))\n    nondiag = any(set(l) & set(\"XY\") for l in H.paulis.to_labels())\n    return {\n        \"H\": name, \"n_terminos\": len(H), \"hermitiano\": bool(np.allclose(H.coeffs.imag, 0)),\n        \"offset_identidad\": round(ident, 4), \"no_diagonal\": nondiag,\n        \"grupos_medida\": len(d[\"groups\"]), \"h_ideal\": round(d[\"h_id\"], 4),\n        \"span\": round(d[\"span\"], 4), \"|h_id|/span\": round(abs(d[\"h_id\"]) / d[\"span\"], 4),\n        \"HIS_raw_bien_condicionado\": abs(d[\"h_id\"]) / d[\"span\"] >= COND_MIN,\n    }\nrev = pd.DataFrame([review_hamiltonian(k, d) for k, d in HAM.items()])\nprint(\"QAOA (gamma,beta) =\", np.round(QAOA, 3), \"| T5 seed =\", Desacople HIS vs AR en CPU (corregido)\n\n$H_\\star$ diagonal, ortogonal al vector de cortes **y con media distinta de cero** (para que la comparación no dependa del offset). Canales: **A** depolarizing, **B** reordenamiento dentro de capas de igual corte (AR constante), **C** fuga de óptimos. p0 /= p0.sum()\nAR_f = lambda p: float(p @ dc_cut / dc_opt)\nHs_f = lambda p: float(p @ H_star)\nhstar_id = Hs_f(p0)\nlayers = defaultdict(list)\nfor x in range(dc_D):\n    layers[int(dc_cut[x])].append(x)\n\ndef chan_A(s): return (1 - s) * p0 + s / dc_D\ndef chan_B(s, rng):\n    out = p0.copy()\n    for c, idx in layers.items():\n        if len(idx) < 2: continue\n        m = p0[idx].sum(); cur = p0[idx] / m\n        out[idx] = m * ((1 - s) * cur + s * rng.dirichlet(np.ones(len(idx))))\n    return out / out.sum()\ndef chan_C(s):\n    out = p0.copy(); opt_i = layers[3]; bad_i = layers[0]\n    mv = s * out[opt_i].sum(); out[opt_i] *= (1 - s); out[bad_i] += mv / len(bad_i)\n    return out / out.sum()\n\nss = np.linspace(0, 0.9, 25)\ndef series(f):\n    ar = np.array([AR_f(f(s)) for s in ss])\n    hs = np.array([his_span(hstar_id, Hs_f(f(s)), span_star) for s in ss])\n    hr = np.array([his_raw(hstar_id, Hs_f(f(s))) for s in ss])\n    return ar, hs, hr\nserA = series(chan_A)\nserB = series(lambda s: chan_B(s, np.random.default_rng(int(1000 * s + 3))))\nserC = series(chan_C)\n\ndef corr_label(ar, his):\n    if np.std(ar) < 1e-9:\n        return float(\"nan\"), \"AR_CONSTANTE\"\n    c = float(np.corrcoef(ar, his)[0, 1]); def __init__(self, M, seed, tls_frac, stale_flip, delta_good, delta_bad, **_):\n        r = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        self.M = M\n        self.edges = [(i, i + 1) for i in range(M - 1)]\n np.ones(self.M))\n        return dict(\n            t2=np.where(tls, 40.0, self.t2b) * j(), t1=np.where(tls, 55.0, self.t1b) * j(),\n            ro=self.ro * np.where(tls, 1.6, 1.0) * j(), g2q=self.p2 true[\"g2q\"][b]))\n            for pair in ((a, b), (b, a)):\n                nm.add_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(min(pe, 0.4), 2), [\"cx\"], list(pair))\n        return nm\n\ndef calib_from_backend(backend):\n    tgt = backend.target; M = backend.num_qubits\n    t1 = np.full(M, 100.0); t2 = np.full(M, 100.0); ro = np.full(M, 0.05); g2 = np.full(M, 0.02)\n    for q in     m = tgt[\"measure\"].get((q,)) if \"measure\" in tgt else None\n        if m is not None and m.error is not None: ro[q] = m.error\n    twoq = next(n for n in (\"cz\", \"ecr\", \"cx\") if n in backend = None\nelse:\n    from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService, SamplerV2\n    service = QiskitRuntimeService()\n    backend = service.backend(BACKEND_NAME)\n    cal_cal, edges = =\", M, \"| status =\", backend.status().status_msg)\n\nadj = defaultdict(list)\nfor a, b in edges:\n    adj[a].append(b); adj[b].append(a)\nfor k in adj: adj[k].sort()\n\nfr_cal = Los valores $d\\mathrm{HIS}=7.4$ y $\\mathrm{corr}=-0.14$ del paso 1 eran artefactos (denominador casi nulo y serie AR numéricamente constante).\n- **T1 vs T5:** en T1 (Ising diagonal) HIS_span y AR son afines, así que `corr ≈ ±1` es esperado y no indica redundancia nueva. El valor diferencial de HIS se prueba en **T5** (no diagonal), donde AR de MaxCut no está definido.\n- **`MODE=\"cpu\"`** valida estimadores (SE calibrado, bootstrap, control nulo) y la tubería; el modelo de dispositivo es sintético, así que ΔHIS no es evidencia para hardware.\n- **`MODE=\"qpu\"`:** el brazo E usa la calibración del backend como \"Ojos\" (no hay sondeo en vivo en este notebook); para un E completo, correr antes el sondeo Ramsey/CPMG de `validacion_estabilidad_qpu.ipynb` y pasar su `fr_live`.\n- Sin mitigación de lectura: HIS mide la integridad del resultado **tal como sale** del dispositivo.","metadata":{}}]}
